meta.title: API Interfaces · origam design system
meta.description: Browse TypeScript prop interfaces used across origam components. Click any interface to see its definition, properties and the components that use it.

hero.subtitle: Every prop interface used across origam components. Fully documented with definitions, properties, extends chains and cross-references to the components that use them.
hero.search_label: Filter interfaces by name or category

catalog.title: All interfaces.
catalog.empty_desc: No interface matches "{query}". Try a different term.

definition.title: Definition
definition.desc: The TypeScript interface definition as found in the origam source. Click the copy icon to copy the snippet.

extends.title: Extends
extends.desc: Parent interfaces this one inherits from. Their properties are available on every consumer of this interface.

props.title: Properties
props.desc: Every property declared by this interface, with its type, optionality and default.

used_by.title: Used by
used_by.desc: Components and composables that extend or consume this interface.

examples.title: Examples
examples.desc: Ready-to-paste code snippets using this interface.
